need: Read and safely project a reviewed public subset into GitHub Stars and Lists without another credential store or destructive synchronization.

discovery.stop_condition: The live native schema exposed repository List items plus create and membership mutations, and REST exposed typed star reads/writes.

contenders.name: official gh over REST and GraphQL
HTML scraping
evidence: preview HTML is not a stable contract

contenders.name: PyGithub, Octokit, or direct token client
replace-all synchronization
evidence: would remove unrelated user state unless the current union is preserved

unknowns: GitHub Lists remain in public preview and may change without a stable numeric platform limit.
The current maintainer token lacks the user scope needed by the observed mutation route.
decision_effect: Target REST 2026-03-10 and live GraphQL schema through argument-vector gh calls; seal pure plans and preserve the union of current plus approved List IDs.
reconsider_when: GitHub publishes a safer dedicated Lists API
